reason.zh: 镜面抛光要求布轮可达，深凹面无法进入，只能局部改为哑光或喷砂。

reason.en: Small ring size needs a custom mandrel
Thin platinum is hard to form
Too few prongs for the stone

first_fix.en: Raise the minimum wall to 0.8 mm or switch to hollow casting with internal supports.
first_fix.zh: 把最小壁厚提到 0.8 mm 以上，或改为空心铸造并加内支撑。

first_fix.en: Thicken to 0.9 mm or route to the vacuum caster at WS-JW-A.
first_fix.zh: 加厚到 0.9 mm 以上，或转一厂真空铸造。

first_fix.en: Split into two sections for site assembly, or add longitudinal support.
first_fix.zh: 分为两段并在现场拼装，或改用纵向支撑。

first_fix.en: Shorten to 900 mm or route to woodworking works A.
first_fix.zh: 缩短到 900 mm 以内，或转木作一厂。

first_fix.en: Convert the critical joints to mortise-and-tenon or dowels, or derate below 40 kg.
first_fix.zh: 关键节点改为榫卯或加定位销，或把载荷降到 40 kg 以下。

first_fix.en: Supply blanks at or below 12% moisture.
first_fix.zh: 改用含水率 12% 以下的坯料。

decisions.notes: Confirmed: 0.3 mm wall plus an unset 8.5 mm stone cannot be produced at this workshop.
Workshop B will route the casting to the vacuum caster of workshop A inside the same order; the reviewer accepts the 0.7 mm wall with a core support and a re-inspection after casting.
